notes.title: Nintendo Switch Version to be Released in Summer 2024!
notes.notes:
The Nintendo Switch version of Refind Self: The Personality Test Game will release this summer!

It's all thanks to our players who have shared their gameplay experience and personality test results on social media, as well as the many content creators who have shared the game and its charms to your audience, that we can release the game on the Switch. Thank you all so much for your support!

Personality test result IDs can be shared and compared across different platforms, so please tell this good news to your friends who would like to join in on their Switch!

notes.title: Patch(Ver:1.1.0207) release [2024/03/28]
notes.notes:
The patch (Ver:1.1.0191) with the following content has been released.
- Fixed the inaccurate 'Action Deviation' values in the appendix.
- Fixed a bug that after 3rd run, all terms in the heart icon menu are marked with a star icon.
- Fixed a bug in the personality comparison screen, the radar chart's shape and values are not accurate.
- Personality details can now be confirmed on the personality comparison screen.
- Fixed minor bugs, and adjusted some UI and in-game text.

notes.title: Patch(Ver:1.1.0182) release [2024/2/2]
notes.notes:
The patch (Ver:1.1.0182) with the following content has been released.
- Fixed an issue where the diagnosis parameter on the behavior screen did not increase.

notes.title: Patch(Ver:1.1.017) release [2024/1/31]
notes.notes:
Patch (Ver:1.1.017) has been released, including the following fixes:
-The personality result IDs will now be uploaded to a new data server, old IDs are also been moved to the new data server.
※When comparing the result ID with other players, patching or not may cause the comparison to fail, or only a partial result is shown.
-Fixed in some cases that the game will show Internet connection is unavailable or the percentage of selection is shown as offline mode, although the Internet is connected.
-Fixed the issue that can't input result IDs or IDs are not shown in 'Compare with many others' when running the game in Simplified Chinese / Traditional Chinese.

notes.title: New track "Ending Theme Piano Version" release (Soundtrack)
notes.notes:
A new track, "Ending Theme Piano Version", has been added to the Soundtrack.
It's exclusive to the Soundtrack and can't be heard in-game

In addition, you can get the sheet music for "Ending Theme Piano Version" and "Main Theme" in the fan kit on the official website.

Purchased tracks may be used freely, such as in videos or as background music in shops. Redistribution of the tracks is forbidden.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2674180

notes.title: Patch(Ver:1.0.210) release for bug fixes [2023/11/15]
notes.notes:
We have released patches(Ver:1.0.210) that fix the following issues.
 - Fixed an issue where you would be unable to progress if you continued to use "Protect" in the command battle minigame.
 - Fixed an issue where the movement button would be displayed when opening and closing the menu while sitting on a bench in the mobile version.
 - Fixed an issue where the character would be encountered as a failure while installing the character.
 - Fixed an issue where the game would become impossible to progress if you went off-screen on the rooftop. (Returns to correct location when scene changes)
 - From the second week onward, the maximum progress value has been increased slightly.
 - Fixed an issue where the points for "Samurai" and "Philosopher" were reversed in certain records.
 - Fine adjustment of personality balance

notes.title: Patch(Ver:1.0.200) release for bug fixes [2023/11/14]
notes.notes:

 - Fixed an issue where the screen would remain black and no progress would be made when progress reduction events overlapped at the start of an event scene or mini-game.
